# `committee_directory_entries`

**Committee directory non-seat entries**

Printed Congressional Directory roster entries that are not committee seats, each labeled with why.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Every printed roster entry that is not a committee seat, in the Congressional Directory editions committee_assignments reads (113th-118th). *(measured 2026-11-08)*

**Data quality.** A row is one printed entry with its granule (or PDF page) line and column: a vacancy, a member of a party organization printed among the select committees (`not_a_committee`), printed text the reader could not seat (`unread_text`, mostly staff and party-office lines), a seat whose committee or member could not be resolved (`unresolved_seat`), or a second printing of a published seat (`duplicate_seat`). Together with the directory rows of committee_assignments it accounts for every printed entry.

- **Parquet file:** `committee_directory_entries.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `congress` | `VARCHAR` | The Congress of the edition that prints the entry. |
| `congress_basis` | `VARCHAR` | `directory`, or `directory-manual` for a reviewed one-off reading of an edition's PDF. |
| `source_granule` | `VARCHAR` | The GovInfo directory granule (or, for a manual reading, package) that prints it. |
| `source_line` | `VARCHAR` | The 1-based granule line (or, for a manual reading, PDF page:line) where the entry starts. |
| `side` | `VARCHAR` | The printed column: chair, majority, minority, single, or line for text read as a whole line. |
| `edition_date` | `VARCHAR` | The edition's dateIssued. |
| `kind` | `VARCHAR` | `vacancy`, `not_a_committee` (a party organization such as the NRCC), `unread_text` (printed text the reader could not seat), `unresolved_seat` (a seat whose committee or member could not be resolved) or `duplicate_seat` (a second printing of a seat already published). |
| `committee_name` | `VARCHAR` | The committee or organization title the entry is printed under. |
| `subcommittee_name` | `VARCHAR` | The subcommittee title, where the entry is printed under one. |
| `printed_text` | `VARCHAR` | The entry as printed. |
| `note` | `VARCHAR` | Why it is not a seat, where the reader or interpreter states a reason. |
